text:
kiara: FYI — Sentinel Health (enterprise pilot) just escalated a hard requirement: they need model `oasis-7b-v2-quant` pinned and available in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. Sales says no cross-region fallback allowed due to data residency/compliance clause. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/agent/tickets/SH-4821

marta: @kiara thanks — do we have `oasis-7b-v2-quant` in the catalog already or is this a new quantized build? also need perf baseline (p95 latency, GPU memory) before we can promise pin+dedicated capacity.

oliver: quick check: we have `oasis-7b-v2` in staging unquantized. Quantized 4-bit variant was tested by infra last month but not published to catalog. Summary:
```
model: oasis-7b-v2-quant
params: ~7B
quant: 4-bit PTQ (rev b)
approx memory/gpu: 10.5GB KV + 6GB model cache (A100 40GB)
p95 token latency (seq=128): ~160ms (single request)
notes: needs kernel path for continuous batching validated on cudnn/torch-optimized runtime
```
We can stage the quant build but need a short validation matrix for prompt shapes and beam sizes.

raj: Sentinel is on a quarterly contract with a compliance clause — they need region pin by 2026-04-15 or they'll escalate procurement. This is high priority from sales. They will not accept auto-fallback to any other variant or region.

kiara: Business impact: production pilot for a hospital network. Acceptance criteria from customer: 1) `oasis-7b-v2-quant` pinned to eu-west-1 and ap-south-1; 2) no automatic regional failover; 3) latency p95 <=200ms for typical prompts; 4) SLO: 99.5% availability during business hours; 5) export controls & audit logging enabled. If any item can't be met we need a written exception.

marta: Proposed triage/next steps: - [ ] infra to validate quantized runtime perf (oliver) - [ ] product to add a backlog ticket with scope + acceptance (i'll create) - [ ] legal/compliance to confirm export control implications - [ ] sales to lock timeline with customer (raj)

product-bot: Backlog item created: https://redwood.example/backlog/PROD-1278 — "Sentinel: oasis-7b-v2-quant region-pin (eu-west-1, ap-south-1)". Priority: high. Linking zendesk SH-4821.

kiara: thanks — i'll add the customer's prioritized prompt set and evaluation expectations to the ticket by EOD.

marta: assigning to eng-runtime for perf verification. tagging @oliver for follow-up.
